text:
max: Starting infra change window for release v2.14 tonight 22:00-00:00 UTC. Plan includes: IAM role updates for model-serving SA, VPC peering cleanup, security-group rule tighten. Tagging @julia @olivia @sre-oncall. We need: module versions pinned, canary apply order, rollback plan. Deploy-bot will kick off after approvals.

julia: I ran `terraform plan` in staging earlier. Diff ok, only 2 policy attachments.

julia: plan snippet:
```
# aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.new_policy will be created
+ resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "new_policy" {
+  role       = "redwood-model-serv"
+  policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess"
+}
```

olivia: Note: attaching policy will grant sagemaker access. We must coordinate key rotation window. Also pin provider and module versions in root module: `hashicorp/aws ~> 4.50`, `redwood/network v1.3.2`.

sre-oncall: Please confirm fallback. If apply fails, we'll rollback by re-applying the previous state snapshot and remove new attachments. Keep Terraform state backup and plan archived.

deploy-bot: release v2.14 infra apply scheduled for 2024-05-27T22:00:00Z. Approvals: 2/2

max: Approvals done. Order: 1) network cleanup, 2) IAM attachments, 3) security-group tighten. Canary: run on us-west-2 first (one host group).

terra-runner: queueing apply. Using workspace: prod. Command:
```
terraform apply -auto-approve -var-file=prod.tfvars -lock-timeout=300s
```

julia: I'll monitor CloudTrail and KMS logs during IAM step. Olivia to handle key rotation.

olivia: Roger. I'll open a short incident channel and post key rotation checklist.

sre-oncall: If rollback invoked, alert paging and run restore script: `scripts/terraform-restore-state.sh <snapshot-id>`

deploy-bot: apply started (job 8921). Streaming logs: ...

terra-runner: apply finished with 0 errors. Changes: +2 resources, ~1 resource modified.

julia: Verified policies attached, sagemaker tests passing on canary.

olivia: Rotated keys, updated secrets manager entry.

max: Closing change window early, monitoring for 30m.

sre-oncall: All green. No rollback needed. :tada:

olivia: I'll update release notes: infra: pinned modules, IAM policy additions, network cleanup.

max: Thanks team. Tagging for audit: @deploy-bot @terra-runner
